name: – Commission proposal
title: CO2 emission performance standards for new passenger cars and new light commercial vehicles for 2025 to 2027 ***I
part_text:
1. The European Commission asks the Council to approve a three-year plan for research and innovation across the EU, called the European Research Area Policy Agenda 2025-2027. It lists 11 long-term policy areas, such as open science, research careers and gender equality, plus 8 specific actions, including work on artificial intelligence in science and research security. Countries take part voluntarily, with no legal obligation, and the plan mainly encourages them to coordinate their national research policies better.

2. Bullet points:
- Countries are invited to follow a shared three-year research plan, but nothing is made compulsory.
- It affects governments, researchers, universities and research funders across the EU and countries linked to the Horizon Europe programme.
- Progress will be tracked through regular reports and a scoreboard; the plan is meant to start in 2025.
